svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Claude Transcripts — architecture
svg.desc: Claude Code — Fires a hook event at each session lifecycle point. webui — React SPA. Optional — losing it costs the UI, not the data. cli — User-facing CLI and admin utility. agents — Anything that speaks the OpenAPI contract. hook — Writes each event, chunk, the end-of-session summary and the transcript through the webapi's ingest routes — the one write interface — and says so at once when a write fails. webapi — Every read goes through it; writes are never proxied. CouchDB — Events, summaries and chunks. Append-only. Garage — S3-compatible object storage — the transcript's sole durable home. Meilisearch — Rebuildable full-text index. Optional — losing it costs search, not history. Fossil — Repositories, wiki and tickets with a web UI, from one binary. Read through the gateway; nothing writes it yet. Claude Code → hook: hooks/scripts/dispatch.ts pipes the payload to `claude-transcripts hook run` and always exits 0. hook → webapi: Events, chunks, the summary and the transcript, through the curated write surface. A failed write is reported, never buffered; `backfill` recovers it. webui → webapi: HTTP cli → webapi: HTTP agents → webapi: HTTP webapi → CouchDB: The curated write surface owns and validates the document shapes; writes are never proxied. webapi → Garage: Transcript bytes live only in S3 (ADR 0014), written by the ingest route. webapi → Fossil: Fossil's JSON API, allowlisted to read-only commands: over GET it would otherwise write. webapi → Meilisearch: search
